headline: Ibovespa Falls as Fiscal Concerns and Global Tech Sell-off Weigh on Markets
summary: The Brazilian Ibovespa index fell 0.82% to 166,191 points, pressured by fiscal uncertainty and a broader risk-off sentiment in Wall Street. The US Nasdaq index dropped 5.5% amid concerns over potential new regulations on artificial intelligence.
why: The Ibovespa is the primary benchmark for the Brazilian stock market. Its performance is highly sensitive to both domestic fiscal policy and global risk appetite, particularly in the technology sector.
why_moved: Global risk-off sentiment, driven by tech-sector regulatory fears, combined with domestic fiscal concerns in Brazil, led to a broad sell-off in equities.
